summary: Observations after d1-omni-600m became the app's default on-device ranker (f5d8cae), with serial inference, cadence bounding and on-demand advice wired into the shipped camera UI. Emulator-only; nothing here is a real-device or aesthetic-quality result.

default_ranker.note: Default APK ships without weights; the 417.7 MiB bundle is an explicit in-app download and the install flow names the model and the LFM Open License v1.0.

rule_layer.observed_rate: about 2.4 analyses/s after serial-inference work (about 0.87/s baseline: 26 analyses in 30 s, 1.12-1.26 s intervals)

scheduling.model_concurrency: single serial pass; no second large-image job queues while one runs
scheduling.scene_change_tracking: unchanged scenes reuse the previous result (FrameSceneTracker); identical box+copy does not re-emit the overlay
scheduling.preview_independence: slow reasoning never blocks the preview; LatestFrameGate keeps only the latest pending frame

d1_gate_observations.portrait_1080x2340: the two-round guarded comparison usually approached or exceeded the 30 s total budget under software rendering; the UI timed out and kept the rule overlay, with the status line naming the model timeout
d1_gate_observations.landscape_540x1170: comparison completed in roughly 16-22 s, but across 70+ standing positions in both orientations the d1 gate outcome was almost always UNSTABLE (two rounds disagreed) or abstain; no stable acceptance was observed for d1 in either orientation
d1_gate_observations.interpretation: Consistent with the offline finding that quantized models give positional answers on static/synthetic scenes and the permutation-consistency gate is deliberately strict. It is an emulator/software-render observation, not a model-quality verdict.

smolvlm_rare_acceptance.event: exactly one stable gate acceptance across dozens of coarse/fine standing positions; it did not reproduce a second time

camera_pipeline_lessons: One ImageAnalysis use case can feed multiple synchronous consumers (rule frame sampler and a 200 ms-self-throttled luma histogram meter) on one executor, instead of opening a second analysis stream.
Analysis-frame size and contact-sheet layout change with orientation; measured model latency must be recorded per orientation/resolution, not as one number.
A 30 s wall-clock budget with honest timeout UI (keep the rule overlay, say so in the status line) is what makes a 16-40 s emulator model usable in a camera app at all.
failure_behavior: Model absent, stale, malformed, undecided, inconsistent across rounds, or over budget: the fresh rule-based box and Chinese rule copy remain; the UI states the actual reason (timeout / comparison failed). No model-generated coordinates or copy are rendered.
open_items: Honor Vs3 real-device latency, thermals, battery and shutter-response under full camera contention
independent labelled composition preference set; aesthetic quality stays not-verified
real-street permutation consistency and hit rate (the 70+ position sweep used the emulator virtual scene)
